concerns: Label-computability pilot relies on a single annotator who is also the owner and author; frozen-protocol replication is still owed.
Self-poisoning corpus is synthetic and authored by the authors; a live-feed realism check is only planned.
Adversarial evaluation uses one attacker (MINJA) and one framework (SuperRed); corpus poisoning and score-feedback optimizers are not run.
Some controls (C4', C5', rank-2 task, post-hoc read-side repair) are post-hoc rather than pre-specified.
Utility is measured only for information work; the action-side cost of the code-enforced read rule remains unpriced.
Ground-axis I1' is specified but not enforced in code; its violation rate is measured only in unlabeled stores.
scholarly_quality.concise_summary: The paper introduces rank-bounded memory, a storage schema that attaches ownership paths and grounds to every memory record, and argues by reachability induction that foreign content cannot silently become the agent's own belief. It measures self-poisoning without an adversary across flat notes, a self-edit block, and three production memory systems (24-33% laundering), shows the attributed store reduces this to 3-6%, and isolates verbatim storage from the structural label via a factorial control. Under MINJA injection, write-time promotion drops to zero with I2+I4, and end-to-end ASR falls from 47% to 10% with the read rule as a prompt and to 1 of 128 with it enforced in code. The paper is transparent about its trusted base, its specified-but-unenforced invariants, and its unpriced action-side utility cost.

evidence.excerpt: What remains this paper's subject is the channel those instruments do not carry: the agent's own speculation re-graded by ordinary consolidation into owner or sensor evidence, with no attacker and no external source to bind; how much, and across which memory systems; and a schema that carries epistemic ownership (whose picture a claim belongs to), not only authority.
evidence.explanation: This clearly delimits the contribution from concurrent work on authority binding, making the novelty claim specific and testable.
evidence.paraphrase: The paper states its subject precisely: the agent's own speculation re-graded by consolidation into owner or sensor evidence, with no attacker, and a schema carrying epistemic ownership.
evidence.section: The Problem: Memory Outlives The Defense

evidence.excerpt: What remains particular here is the axis those instruments do not carry: the agent's own speculation re-graded into owner or sensor evidence — ground and I1′, a laundering channel with no external source to bind, and the dominant error direction of Section 6 — together with the longitudinal per-checkpoint instrument, the rewrite × label factorial over production systems as shipped, and the rank-2 layer.
evidence.explanation: The novelty claim is carefully scoped against prior and concurrent work, acknowledging shared observations while identifying the unoccupied channel.
evidence.paraphrase: The paper positions itself against TMA-NM and two concurrent works, claiming the remaining distinction is the epistemic ground axis and rank-2 layer.

evidence.excerpt: the same tracer is measured up to twelve times, so the 95% intervals are a cluster bootstrap over tracers (10,000 resamples of the 26 tracer clusters; artifact, stats.py, which is the single source for every interval and paired figure in this section); per-observation Wilson intervals would treat the repeats as independent and overstate precision roughly threefold.
evidence.explanation: This shows statistical care appropriate to the repeated-measures design, avoiding overstated precision.
evidence.paraphrase: The paper uses cluster bootstrap over tracers rather than per-observation Wilson intervals, acknowledging repeated measurements of the same tracer.
evidence.section: Is The Label Needed? Self-Poisoning Without An Adversary

evidence.excerpt: The interaction is the finding. Without rewriting, stripping the labels costs little: verbatim records keep their lexical hedges, C4′ (5.7%, haiku 9.5 / gemini 2.0) stays far below the band, and the rendered label's own effect (3.1% against 5.7%) is within these intervals. Under compression the label is decisive: the same records, model and budget return to the unlabeled band (28.0%) the moment the labels are gone
evidence.explanation: This 2x2 design (rewrite or not, label or not) directly tests the mechanism rather than relying on a single comparison.
evidence.paraphrase: The factorial control C4' vs C5' isolates the effect of the label under compression, showing the label is decisive when rewriting is forced.
evidence.section: Is The Label Needed? Self-Poisoning Without An Adversary

evidence.excerpt: So this section reports a measured reduction, 24–33% brought to 3–6%, not unreachability. The "by construction" claim does not extend here, and the residual is what an enforced I1′ would have to close.
evidence.explanation: This prevents overclaiming: the formal guarantee is separated from the empirical reduction, and the residual is attributed to the unenforced I1'.
evidence.paraphrase: The paper explicitly limits the 'by construction' claim to the rank axis and reports a measured reduction, not unreachability, for the ground axis.
evidence.section: Is The Label Needed? Self-Poisoning Without An Adversary

evidence.excerpt: TMA-NM's arms vary what authority is bound to (content trust scoring, derivation lineage, session capability IFC, origin) and include no arm that exposes the same origin labels through the prompt; our ladder varies where the same labels are enforced (read by a prompt they leave 10%, read by code 1 of 128), isolating a variable TMA-NM does not and landing on the same side: action authority enforced in code over the labels, not asked of the model.
evidence.explanation: The related-work comparison is adequate for the actual claims: it identifies the precise complementary variable and concedes shared observations rather than overstating novelty.
evidence.paraphrase: The paper distinguishes its variable (where labels are enforced) from TMA-NM's variable (what authority is bound to), and acknowledges the storage-level seat is no longer empty.

evidence.excerpt: The Self-Poisoning Bench of Section 6 is published in full as the artifact of this record: the deterministic corpus generator and both storylines in English and Russian, the replay harness with the five scripted policies and the adapters for mem0, Letta and Graphiti (pinned versions), the panel judge, every stored model output (memory snapshots per session, answers, judgments), the blind adjudication sample and scores, and a reproduction script that regenerates every verdict file and table byte-identically without API calls.
evidence.explanation: This is a strong reproducibility commitment, including pre-registered rubric and artifact commands.
evidence.paraphrase: The full benchmark, corpora, model outputs, and a byte-identical regeneration script are published with a DOI.

evidence.excerpt: I5 is specified, not evaluated. No task in Sections 6–7 plants an assumed-ground record; its isolation is a schema rule carried from the architecture document, not a measured one. promote is specified, never exercised. No run in Sections 6–7 executed the explicit promotion operation: zero executions across the program
evidence.explanation: This is an exemplary limitations section that prevents readers from inferring guarantees the paper does not make.
evidence.paraphrase: The paper enumerates what is specified but not enforced (I5, promote, general I2'/I4) and what is measured but not priced (action-side utility).

evidence.excerpt: Three kinds of number meet in this section, and they are not the same measurement: the human ceiling is test–retest self-consistency, the panel numbers are accuracy against an adjudicated key, and the human's 87.0–88.9% is accuracy against a key the same annotator helped adjudicate. Each mismatch biases the comparison in the human's favor
evidence.explanation: This precision about what each measurement means and how biases run is a mark of careful presentation.
evidence.paraphrase: The paper distinguishes three kinds of numbers in the annotation section (human ceiling, panel accuracy, human accuracy against a key the annotator helped adjudicate) and states the direction of bias.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The paper presents a coherent, well-scoped contribution: a storage-schema defense (rank-bounded memory) against attribution laundering in LLM agents, with a formal reachability argument, a measured self-poisoning benchmark, and adversarial evaluation. The claims are carefully bounded and the limitations section is unusually thorough. The empirical work includes multiple memory systems, two storylines, two languages, cluster-bootstrapped intervals, human and independent adjudication, and a factorial control isolating verbatim storage from the structural label. The adversarial section decomposes end-to-end ASR into storage promotion and read-side violation, and traces the single residual failure. The paper is transparent about what is specified versus enforced, what is measured versus assumed, and what remains unpriced. The main weaknesses are a single author-annotator for the label-computability pilot, a synthetic corpus, one attacker/framework, and some post-hoc controls, but these are explicitly disclosed and do not undermine the central measured claims.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The central claims are well supported by the supplied text, but several measurements rest on a single annotator who is also the author, a synthetic corpus, one attacker, and some post-hoc controls. The frozen-protocol replication for the annotation pilot is explicitly owed. These are disclosed limitations rather than hidden flaws, so the uncertainty is scientific rather than a coverage failure.
